label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Takes LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf Korea in a playoff over Talor Gooch for his eighth LIV title, the most since 2022, as LIV seeks new funding after Saudi PIF ends support in 2026.

items.headline: Potgieter's Bogey-Free Record
items.text: Malan Potgieter extended his NCAA bogey-free streak to 91 holes, breaking the previous NCAA record of 74 and approaching Tiger Woods’ pro record of 110.
